reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: Email scam
reports.description:
This Bitcoin address is used in a 419 email scam (advance-fee scam). A scammer (manuelfranco20@yahoo.com) emailed me claiming to be Manuel Franco (the name of a real lottery winner), and said that they would like to send some of the money he won from the lottery to me. The scammer asked me to email their lawyer Mike Anderson (mikeanderson01010@gmail.com, of course this is not the scammers actual name). The lawyer then told me that I need to pay $550 as a legal fee to receive the donation money through Bitcoin.  
_x000D_
This is obviously a 419 advance-fee scam, and if somebody was to actually pay the $550, the scammer(s) would have vanished with the money because the donation money doesnt actually exist. Of course, none of the names used by the scammer(s) are their real name(s), which leaves little to no information about their actual identities.
